governance_note: Repository implementation evidence is not a human acceptance, release, or production observation record.

requirements.title: Production model capabilities

status_history.reason: Five declared production capabilities still use fallback or placeholder artifacts.

product_context.problem: Declared biometric capability must be backed by commercially lawful, evaluated artifacts.
success_metrics: All quality gates pass on fixed held-out data

known_limitations: Required external model and legal evidence is unavailable in this repository

current_state_mapping: Reuse model package, capability registry, evaluation, cutover, and runtime adapter layers.
behavior: Register artifact, verify digest and sidecars, evaluate fixed cohorts, approve, prewarm, canary, then activate; fail closed on any missing artifact or gate.
rules: Rollback restores the previous approved artifact
data: Model package, model card, license evidence, evaluation report, cohort thresholds, release audit

criteria: All declared capabilities use non-fallback artifacts and pass fixed-cohort evaluation
acceptance.observation_window: At least one approved canary window per model

requirements.implementation_state: Runtime, governance, and fail-closed gates implemented; external artifacts blocked

blockers.description: Lawful production artifacts and fixed held-out evaluations are missing for appearance, face_detection, face_embedding, gait, and pose.
blockers.resolution_evidence: Signed model cards, license review, artifact digests, cohort evaluation reports, and strict cutover output

requirements.title: Production dependency and recovery drills

status_history.reason: Drill schemas and gates exist, but target-environment fault, recovery, backup, rollback, and alert timelines have not been observed.

product_context.problem: Deployment claims require real dependency and recovery evidence.
product_context.value: Makes availability and recovery commitments defensible.

out_of_scope: Customer-specific disaster recovery beyond contracted topology
known_limitations: No target-environment drill evidence is stored

current_state_mapping: Reuse production backends, health checks, migrations, consistency checks, and evidence packaging.
behavior: Install, migrate, smoke, inject faults, verify alerts, recover, reconcile data, roll back, and sign evidence.
rules: Every drill records timestamps and operators
Recovery must reconcile all authoritative stores

criteria: Real target topology completes installation, fault, backup, restore, upgrade, and rollback drills
acceptance.observation_window: One complete drill cycle for every supported delivery profile

requirements.implementation_state: Production adapters, drill schema, and fail-closed release gate implemented

blockers.description: Real target topology and operator-signed drill outputs are unavailable.
blockers.resolution_evidence: Signed recovery drill reports for installation, fault, backup, restore, N-1 upgrade, and rollback

requirements.title: Performance and capacity baseline

status_history.reason: Capacity protocol is complete but has no real GPU and production-backend observations for all three topologies.

product_context.problem: Sizing and SLA need reproducible load evidence.
product_context.value: Supports hardware selection, pricing, and scale limits.

current_state_mapping: Extend load tooling, metrics, vector quality checks, and delivery evidence schema.
behavior: Warm up, sample, record latency and resources, verify quality, derive headroom and scale recommendations.

criteria: All required scenarios and topologies have reproducible performance, resource, and quality observations
acceptance.observation_window: Three stable repetitions per scenario and topology

requirements.implementation_state: Capacity protocol and validation harness implemented; measurements blocked

blockers.description: Real GPU measurements with production models/backends are missing for single-node, dual-node, and target-cluster topologies.
blockers.resolution_evidence: Signed capacity report containing all required observations and repetitions

requirements.title: Dynamic batching and inference scheduling

status_history.reason: Scheduler behavior is tested, but the required production-model A/B throughput and latency result depends on the blocked capacity run.

product_context.problem: Static request execution wastes GPU capacity and can starve tenants.
product_context.value: Improves throughput with bounded latency and fairness.

known_limitations: Real A/B evidence awaits production models and GPU capacity run

current_state_mapping: Extend runtime execution and bounded batch concurrency.
behavior: Queue by model pool and tenant, batch within latency budget, cancel expired work, degrade safely.
rules: Batching can be disabled per pool

criteria: Functional fairness and cancellation tests pass and real A/B meets default thresholds
acceptance.observation_window: Capacity A/B repetitions for every production model pool

requirements.implementation_state: Scheduler implementation and contract tests complete; performance acceptance blocked

blockers.description: Production-model GPU A/B capacity evidence is missing.
blockers.resolution_evidence: Per-model-pool A/B report linked to PERF-P0-03

requirements.title: Kubernetes elasticity and canary delivery

status_history.reason: Manifests and static contracts exist; real HA, scaling, canary, migration, and node-failure drills are not available.
Release materialization now requires distinct immutable image digests and a real host, and validates 27 rendered resources; target-cluster drills remain external.

product_context.problem: Large deployments need repeatable scaling, isolation, canary, and rollback.
product_context.value: Provides a supportable HA deployment topology.
success_metrics: All workloads healthy under node loss

assumptions: GPU device plugin and metrics are installed
known_limitations: Static manifest tests do not prove cluster behavior

current_state_mapping: Extend existing container and worker entry points with Kustomize workloads.
behavior: Materialize stable and canary manifests from distinct immutable digests, validate all rendered resources, preflight migrations and models, scale by load, canary, drain, and roll back.

criteria: Rendered release uses distinct immutable stable/canary digests and target cluster passes HA, scale, canary, migration, and node-failure drills
acceptance.observation_window: One full drill on the target cluster topology

requirements.implementation_state: Kubernetes base, immutable release materializer, policies, autoscaling, canary, and migration jobs implemented; target-cluster evidence blocked

blockers.description: No operator-signed target-cluster HA, autoscaling, canary, or node-failure evidence.
blockers.resolution_evidence: Target-cluster drill report and signed deployment evidence package

requirements.title: Model hot update, prewarm, and cache consistency

status_history.reason: Fingerprint, trusted configuration reload, prewarm, alias CAS, and rollback contracts are implemented and under verification.

product_context.problem: Model updates must avoid cold starts and mixed versions.
product_context.value: Reduces release interruption and makes rollback deterministic.

known_limitations: Real canary observation remains a release-stage activity

current_state_mapping: Extend config hot reload, runtime registry, and model alias writer.
behavior: Validate config, load immutable artifact, prewarm, CAS alias, drain previous runtime, roll back on failure.

criteria: Hot update rejects invalid artifacts, preserves request fingerprint consistency, and rolls back aliases
acceptance.observation_window: One canary window before production alias promotion

requirements.implementation_state: Implemented; automated and staging verification pending sign-off

requirements.title: Model registry and governance lifecycle

status_history.reason: Registry lifecycle, provenance, evaluation, approvals, release preflight, shadow, canary, active, and rollback controls are implemented.

product_context.problem: Production result must trace to artifact, data, evaluation, approval, and rollout.
product_context.value: Creates an auditable model supply chain.
success_metrics: Every active model is fully traceable

known_limitations: Actual production model registration awaits MOD-P0-01

current_state_mapping: Reuse rollout execution and add a versioned registry control plane.
behavior: Register provenance, attach evaluation, enforce separation of duties, release through shadow/canary, activate or roll back.

criteria: Registry enforces provenance, quality, digest, approval, and release state contracts
acceptance.observation_window: One complete shadow-to-active or rollback workflow

requirements.implementation_state: Implemented; verification and human governance sign-off pending

requirements.title: Feedback, annotation, and dataset lifecycle

status_history.reason: Sample governance, redaction, deduplication, annotation exchange, conflict handling, and dataset manifests are implemented.
Immutable feedback analysis reports now freeze input, manifest, and model digests and provide error analysis, read-only threshold suggestions, model comparisons, and release hold/recommend decisions.

product_context.problem: Low-confidence and business feedback samples need lawful, traceable reuse.
product_context.value: Turns feedback into reproducible model improvement data.

assumptions: Only explicitly eligible samples enter the pool
known_limitations: External annotation service credentials and privacy acceptance require delivery configuration

current_state_mapping: Extend review and threshold signals with a feedback control plane.
behavior: Select eligible sample, redact, deduplicate, export scoped task, import with conflict control, freeze dataset manifest.

criteria: Eligible samples remain isolated, annotation conflicts are controlled, dataset manifests are reproducible, and analysis reports fail closed on insufficient or digest-inconsistent evidence
acceptance.observation_window: One complete export/import/dataset freeze and model-comparison workflow

requirements.implementation_state: Implemented with immutable analysis evidence and read-only threshold/release decisions; privacy and connector acceptance pending

requirements.title: Customer self-service and commercial operations

status_history.reason: Lifecycle, signed license, entitlement, quota, usage, cost, support, and offboarding closure gates are implemented.
High-risk commercial operations now require typed confirmation and recent local or forced OIDC interactive authentication; non-interactive credentials fail closed.

Scheduled commercial and entitlement lifecycle changes, immutable usage/reversal events, versioned cost models, daily/monthly timezone aggregation, resource attribution, budget alerts, and quota exhaustion forecasting are implemented.

product_context.problem: Customers need explainable access, entitlements, consumption, and lifecycle controls.
product_context.value: Reduces manual operations and prevents entitlement leakage.

assumptions: Contract data is entered by authorized staff

current_state_mapping: Extend access, application, project, quota, and call-log modules.
behavior: Provision or schedule profile and entitlement changes with CAS and rollback, enforce project/stream/concurrency limits, record immutable usage and reversals, attribute parameterized cost, forecast quotas, restrict grace, and close only after access disablement and deletion evidence.

criteria: Scheduled lifecycle, allocations, immutable metering/reversal, daily/monthly attribution, support, grace, and deletion-backed closure work end to end
acceptance.observation_window: One standard customer onboarding-to-offboarding and metering reconciliation workflow

requirements.implementation_state: Implemented with scheduled lifecycle, rollback, immutable metering/cost attribution, and interactive step-up; product, privacy, and E2E acceptance pending

requirements.title: SLA, incidents, and operations cockpit

status_history.reason: Versioned SLA calculation, incident lifecycle, health timeline, support cases, and console views are implemented.

product_context.problem: Service commitments and incidents need one versioned, explainable record.

known_limitations: Contract SLA and 30-day production observation require human approval

current_state_mapping: Extend existing SLO, metrics, call logs, and operations pages.
behavior: Version SLA, compute report, open incident, append CAS timeline, recover, close, publish customer view.

criteria: SLA calculation is reproducible and incident/support lifecycles are complete and isolated

requirements.implementation_state: Implemented; operational verification and observation pending

requirements.title: SDK and developer experience

status_history.reason: Python product SDK, compatibility policy, retries, resumable upload, webhook verification, and multi-language clients are implemented.
Version 0.17.0 wheel built and installed without dependencies in a clean virtual environment; the installed package passed live health plus API compatibility checks against an isolated service.
Version 0.18.0 wheel, product compatibility policy, clean-environment smoke path, webhook verification and multi-language version contracts are documented and covered by release verification.

product_context.problem: Integrators need safe retries, stable errors, uploads, webhooks, and compatibility guidance.
product_context.value: Shortens time to first successful integration.

out_of_scope: Every language at equal feature depth
known_limitations: Package publication and customer integration observation are external

current_state_mapping: Productize existing Python, Node, Java, and Go client surfaces.
behavior: Authenticate, call APIs, retry only safe/idempotent operations, resume uploads, wait jobs, verify webhooks.

criteria: SDK handles retries, idempotency, resumable upload, jobs, webhooks, and compatibility according to contract
acceptance.observation_window: One clean-environment integration smoke run per supported version

requirements.implementation_state: Implemented; repeatable clean-environment package and live compatibility smoke passed; customer acceptance remains external

requirements.title: Video and streaming productization

status_history.reason: Chunked upload, resume, checkpoints, priority queues, stream profiles, callbacks, and timeline console flows are implemented.

product_context.problem: Long media workflows need resumability, progress, stable callbacks, and controlled resources.

known_limitations: Real long-duration and network-failure observation remains required

current_state_mapping: Extend existing video jobs, stream workers, tracking, and console pages.
behavior: Upload parts idempotently, complete digest, enqueue, checkpoint, pause/resume, emit signed callbacks, render timeline.

criteria: Uploads and jobs resume idempotently, queues preserve priority, streams apply governed profiles, and callbacks are verifiable
acceptance.observation_window: One long-duration video and stream recovery run

requirements.title: Enterprise compliance delivery evidence

status_history.reason: COM-001 through COM-012 controls and signed package tooling are implemented, but applicability, legal approval, and real production evidence are external.
High-risk compliance mutations and rights export now require recent interactive authentication; external legal applicability and signed production evidence remain unavailable.

COM-001 through COM-012 now enforce control-specific semantics and COM-006 gates rights, feedback, and administrator exports in commercial mode; external legal applicability and production approvals remain unavailable.

product_context.problem: Security, privacy, model, supply-chain, and operations claims need one verifiable package.
product_context.value: Supports delivery review without overstating compliance.

known_limitations: Legal conclusions and production signatures cannot be fabricated by repository automation

current_state_mapping: Aggregate privacy, supply chain, governance, audit, operations, and model evidence.
behavior: Record applicability and control data, approve with evidence, process rights requests, build redacted package, sign, verify, and gate release.
rules: All 12 controls require typed semantic validation before approval
COM-006 approval gates every export surface in commercial mode
No secrets or raw sensitive samples

criteria: Applicable COM controls pass control-specific semantic validation and signed package is complete, redacted, independently verifiable, and approved
acceptance.observation_window: One customer-scoped package review and independent verification

requirements.implementation_state: Control-specific compliance semantics, export gates, rights workflows, and package tooling implemented; legal and production evidence blocked

blockers.description: Customer/jurisdiction applicability, legal basis, filing thresholds, impact assessment, and production package approvals are unavailable.
blockers.resolution_evidence: Signed applicability matrix, DPIA/PIPIA decision, control approvals, and independently verified delivery package

requirements.title: Versioned industry solution templates

status_history.reason: Five immutable versioned templates, previews, diffs, application history, fingerprints, and rollback are implemented.

All five template acceptance manifests now exist, declare synthetic contract cases, expose SHA-256 evidence, bind fingerprints, and fail closed when missing; customer and capacity validation remain external.

product_context.problem: Industry delivery must reuse the core product instead of creating customer branches.
product_context.value: Shortens configuration while preserving governance and rollback.

known_limitations: Customer validation is still required before production use

current_state_mapping: Add template metadata over existing commercial, threshold, retention, alert, and compliance configuration.
behavior: Select version, preview diff, validate constraints, approve, apply atomically, record fingerprint, and roll back.
rules: Acceptance manifest required and digest bound

criteria: Multiple industries use the same code path with explicit diffs, digest-bound acceptance manifests, fingerprints, and reversible application
acceptance.observation_window: One customer acceptance workflow per enabled industry template
